newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index rises on improved prices.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index rises on improved prices.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index rose on Tuesday on improved share prices in a market that remained fairly stable, bourse officials said.
The index rose 2.01 points to stand at 3022.40. Turnover was posted at 8.150 million shillings on 224,654 shares from 8.343 million shillings on 236,334 shares on Monday.

"There was no major strong activity experienced in the market, only one big prompt lot dealt for Kenya Commercial Bank," a stock exchange official said. "A few (shares) experienced an improvement in their prices while the rest continued to hold stable."
"The financial sector dominated the market with good volumes traded on the Housing Finance Company, Kenya Commercial Bank and National Bank of Kenya shares," a senior broker said.

The broker described a primary issue in Kenya Commercial Bank as "very successful" and added: "I expect the issue to be oversubscribed and the market price to continue selling at the going market price."
Kenya Commercial Bank has also forecast its profits to rise to 2.5 billion shillings in 1996 from 2.4 billion shillings last year. That has added strength to its shares, dealers said.
The agricultural sector remained subdued with 143 shares of Brooke Bond traded at 178, and 4,100 shares of Rea Vipingo traded at 10.85.
Kenya Airways was unchanged at 9.70 while Uchumi Supermarket traded 6,190 shares at 46.75 from 46.50.
Marginal volumes were traded in the Industrial sector with foreign investors buying 1,500 shares of Kenya Breweries and 1,250 shares of East African Portland Cement at 21.25.
